name: Joaosnken Domain Verification for Oceani
author: joaosnken

sections.description:
This plugin allows website owners to verify their domains using the Oceani API.
It sends the website URL, site type, and email address to a secure endpoint and confirms domain ownership.

Perfect for developers or website admins who need a simple, automated domain verification system.

External services

This plugin connects to the Oceani API to register and verify websites.
It sends the user’s website URL, site type, and email address to the API endpoint:
https://fraliisocean.space/oceani/api/cadastro/direct

Terms of Service: https://fraliisocean.space/terms
Privacy Policy: https://fraliisocean.space/privacy

Make sure you have an account and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before using the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the joaosnken-domain-verification-for-oceani folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Joaosnken Domain Verification to configure your site.
  4. Fill in the required fields and click “Register Website” to complete verification.
sections.faq:
Is my data safe?

Yes. The plugin only sends the website URL, site type, and email address for verification. No other data is transmitted.

Can I use this on multiple sites?

Yes, each site must be registered individually.

I get an error message after submitting, what should I do?

Ensure the website URL and email are correct and try again. Errors may also appear if the external API is unreachable.
